```sql
WITH r0 AS (SELECT `books_receivable_items`.* FROM `books_receivable_items` WHERE EXISTS (SELECT (1) FROM (SELECT 1) `__rule` LEFT JOIN `users` `__auth_users` ON `__auth_users`.`id`='ywjpywln37zmttt' LEFT JOIN `books_access` `__collection_alias_me` WHERE ('ywjpywln37zmttt' IS NOT '' AND [[__auth_users.disabled]] IS NOT 1 AND [[__collection_alias_me.user]] = 'ywjpywln37zmttt' AND [[__collection_alias_me.can_read]] = 1))),
r1 AS (SELECT `books_customers`.* FROM `books_customers` WHERE EXISTS (SELECT (1) FROM (SELECT 1) `__rule` LEFT JOIN `users` `__auth_users` ON `__auth_users`.`id`='ywjpywln37zmttt' LEFT JOIN `books_access` `__collection_alias_me` WHERE ('ywjpywln37zmttt' IS NOT '' AND [[__auth_users.disabled]] IS NOT 1 AND [[__collection_alias_me.user]] = 'ywjpywln37zmttt' AND [[__collection_alias_me.can_read]] = 1))),
w AS (SELECT [[t1.id]] AS __id, NULLIF([[t2.id]], '') AS c0, NULLIF([[t2.id]], '') AS c9, [[t1.item]] AS c10, [[t1.currency]] AS ck0, COALESCE(NULLIF([[t3.id]], ''), NULLIF([[t2.id]], '')) AS k0, NULLIF([[t2.id]], '') AS k1, [[t1.item]] AS k2, [[t1.debit]] AS h8, [[t1.credit]] AS h9, NULLIF(substr([[t1.due_date]], 1, 10), '') AS h10, [[t1.item_seq]] AS h11, NULLIF([[t1.item_kind]], '') AS h12, [[t1.item_number]] AS h13
```
```sql
FROM r0 t1
LEFT JOIN r1 t2 ON [[t2.id]] = [[t1.customer]]
```

## Run 5 customer opened, statement 6

```sql
WITH r0 AS (SELECT `books_receivable_items`.* FROM `books_receivable_items` WHERE EXISTS (SELECT (1) FROM (SELECT 1) `__rule` LEFT JOIN `users` `__auth_users` ON `__auth_users`.`id`='ywjpywln37zmttt' LEFT JOIN `books_access` `__collection_alias_me` WHERE ('ywjpywln37zmttt' IS NOT '' AND [[__auth_users.disabled]] IS NOT 1 AND [[__collection_alias_me.user]] = 'ywjpywln37zmttt' AND [[__collection_alias_me.can_read]] = 1))),
r1 AS (SELECT `books_customers`.* FROM `books_customers` WHERE EXISTS (SELECT (1) FROM (SELECT 1) `__rule` LEFT JOIN `users` `__auth_users` ON `__auth_users`.`id`='ywjpywln37zmttt' LEFT JOIN `books_access` `__collection_alias_me` WHERE ('ywjpywln37zmttt' IS NOT '' AND [[__auth_users.disabled]] IS NOT 1 AND [[__collection_alias_me.user]] = 'ywjpywln37zmttt' AND [[__collection_alias_me.can_read]] = 1))),
w AS (SELECT [[t1.id]] AS __id, NULLIF([[t2.id]], '') AS c0, NULLIF([[t2.id]], '') AS c9, [[t1.item]] AS c10, [[t1.currency]] AS ck0, COALESCE(NULLIF([[t3.id]], ''), NULLIF([[t2.id]], '')) AS k0, NULLIF([[t2.id]], '') AS k1, [[t1.item]] AS k2, [[t1.debit]] AS h8, [[t1.credit]] AS h9, NULLIF(substr([[t1.due_date]], 1, 10), '') AS h10, [[t1.item_seq]] AS h11, NULLIF([[t1.item_kind]], '') AS h12, [[t1.item_number]] AS h13
FROM r0 t1
LEFT JOIN r1 t2 ON [[t2.id]] = [[t1.customer]]
LEFT JOIN r1 t3 ON [[t3.id]] = [[t2.parent]]
WHERE (([[t1.settled]] > '2026-11-18') AND (NULLIF(substr([[t1.date]], 1, 10), '') <= '2026-11-18'))),
```
